name: anim_koya_form
subject: a slim, lean-muscled dog man made of glossy brown paint with broad diagonal cream bands and a bushy tail
desc: The faceless paint humanoid finishes forming: the legs pull up out of the puddle into straight human legs with bare feet, the head blob stretches into a dog muzzle, the pointed ears and the spiky hair with long bangs pull up out of the paint, the bushy tail pulls out behind, the mouth forms a sly closed-mouth smirk, and the eyes open last. Slow, sticky, viscous, dripping. It ends exactly in the standing pose of the last frame.
